articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How China’s Cybersecurity Software Ban At Check Point Software Technologies (CHKP) Has Changed Its Investment Story. In early January 2026, Chinese authorities ordered domestic firms to stop using cybersecurity software from several US and Israeli vendors, including Check Point Software Technologies, citing national security concerns and a push toward homegrown alternatives. Despite the broad scope of the ban, Check Point’s direct financial exposure to China is relatively small, as the country accounts for only a low-single-digit percentage of its overall revenue. articles.title: Realtor.com® December Rent Report: Relief Skips Many Lower-Cost Renters
articles.mainIdea: Realtor.com® December Rent Report: Relief Skips Many Lower-Cost Renters
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Realtor.com® December Rent Report: Relief Skips Many Lower-Cost Renters. Asking rents declined for the 29th consecutive month year over year in December, but the latest data show the easing is increasingly concentrated among higher-priced rentals, leaving many lower-cost renters with little relief. The median asking rent across the 50 largest U.S. metros was $1,689, down 0.7% from December 2024, according to the Realtor.com® December Rental Report. Related tickers mentioned: NWS, NWSA.
